segments.text: Tony hit the pavement with the sun half asleep
One hand on the wheel, one hand keeping time
He said, no man can tell me where the good nights keep
Then laughed at the traffic and crossed every line
His jacket caught rain from a passing cloud
his heart made a racket his radio loud at the corner store with a soda and a grin

through the daylight how that would seem a little bit nasty wild and free his wife saw the headlight
